preamble: The voiceless alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕ] is retracted to the retroflex affricate [ʈʂ]. In the history of Mandarin, the Middle Chinese 章 (Zhāng) series of palatal initials merged with the retroflex 知 and 莊 series, so Middle Chinese tɕ- surfaces as Mandarin zh- [ʈʂ] (章 zhāng, 照 zhào, 終 zhōng). The change belongs to the northern (Mandarin) development; no comparable case has been verified outside Sinitic.
